notes.title: Two New SkyDrift DLC's: Gladiator Pack and Extreme Fighters Pack
notes.content:
The Gladiator Multiplayer Pack and the Extreme Fighters Premium Airplane Pack are now available for SkyDrift on Steam!

The Gladiator Pack introduces both Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch into SkyDrift along with six multiplayer arenas!

The Extreme Fighters Airplane Pack adds three new deadly planes for use in all modes!

notes.title: New Release - SkyDrift
notes.content:
SkyDrift is now available on Steam!

Get closer than ever before to the world of adrenaline pumping sky-racing where flyboys can test and master their flying and combat skills against the deadliest opponents! The goal is simple: If you can’t overtake them, shoot them down!

Purchase before November 28th at 10AM Pacific Time and receive the Gladiator Multiplayer Pack, including 6 Deathmatch Arenas, for Free!
